plugins.description: List of core collectd plugins to load. Each plugin must be present in the plugin directory.

plugin_configs.description: List of plugin-specific configuration blocks. Each element defines a plugin with its options.

options.description: Key-value config options for this plugin. Lists are rendered with one item per line.

comments.description: Optional per-option comments to prepend above each line (for clarity in generated config)

types.description: Optional hints to distinguish list-typed options for rendering (e.g., {'values': 'list'})

include_fragments.description: List of file paths to include as additional configuration fragments (e.g., /etc/collectd/collectd.conf.d/*.conf).

log_level.description: Log verbosity level. Use 'debug' for troubleshooting.

fqdn_lookup.description: Enable or disable FQDN hostname resolution. Disable if DNS is unreliable or containers lack DNS.
